::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 10th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Tig Lang
:::

Madam
I wrote you a letter about your MS, and sent it to the address on the MS itself, at Gosport so I hope you have received it
yours truly
C M Yonge
